newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - ADM buy reiterated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ADM buy reiterated.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth analyst Bonnie Wittenburg said Monday she had reiterated her buy rating on Archer Daniels Midland Co after the company announced it had entered into an agreement with the U.S. Justice Department settling charges related to price-fixing.

-- ADM agreed to pay $70 million in fines on price-fixing in lysine, a feed additive, and $30 million in fines on price-fising in citric acid, which is used in food and beverages. The settlement also ends a probe of high fructose corn syrup.

-- "We view this announcement as very positive for ADM," Wittenburg wrote in a report. "The company has at long last put this whole price-fixing case behind it and can now focus its efforts entirely on growing its businesses."
-- Wittenburg said she set a target price of $25 a share for the agribusiness giant.
-- ADM shares were up 3/4 to 21-3/8, a new 52-week high.

-- She said her price target was based on a price-to-earnings multiple of 15 times the calendar 1997 earnings estimate of $1.65. For fiscal 1997 ending in June, Wittenburg estimates earnings of $1.50 a share.
-- "Our target multiple of 15 times for ADM represents a discount of over 15 percent to the S&P Industrials and may prove to be conservative, given the broader market's strength," Wittenburg said.
